investigation_summary.original_hypothesis: Only 1 GLB saved to R2 across 3+ games — pipeline severely broken
investigation_summary.actual_finding: Pipeline is healthy. 159 GLBs in R2. Multiple games have 5-6 assets each.

per_game_clusters.notes: game #85 Arctic Frost Run — all refined ~4MB

older_empties.explanation: No credit_before/after data — generated before credit tracking was added, or while MESHY_DEV_MODE=true

root_cause_of_placeholder_cubes.actual_cause: Play button was firing during script_ready phase (Lua done, Meshy still running). assetUrlsJson = '{}' at that point. Unity loaded game with empty manifest → all Object.Create('model:*') fell back to colored placeholder cubes.
root_cause_of_placeholder_cubes.fix_applied: react/src/screens/CreateScreen.tsx — play button state machine with assetsReady gate and PlayAnywayModal. Also fixed GameLauncher.cs to not destroy preview on failed play.

games_80_82.likely_cause: Individual Meshy tasks failed (FAILED status from waitForTask) — pipeline caught these in resolveManifest try/catch and returned empty URL for those assets
games_80_82.impact: Affected assets showed placeholder cubes, others showed real 3D models
games_80_82.fix: Added retry to meshyFetch for 429 and 5xx errors — reduces failure rate for transient Meshy API issues

improvements_made.change: meshyFetch now retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s) on HTTP 429 and 5xx errors. Network failures also retry. Hard errors (4xx except 429) throw immediately.
improvements_made.benefit: Reduces partial-game failures caused by transient Meshy rate limits or server hiccups

improvements_made.change: Added per-stage logging in resolveAsset: START with cacheKey/semaphore state, preview task ID, preview completion, refine task ID, refine completion, GLB download size, R2 upload result. Errors upgraded from console.warn to console.error at critical failure points.
improvements_made.benefit: Full visibility into exactly which stage each asset fails at — enables rapid diagnosis of future pipeline issues

pipeline_health_verified.semaphore: Releases correctly in finally block — no deadlock
pipeline_health_verified.in_flight_dedup: Registered before IIFE yields, deleted in finally — no race condition
pipeline_health_verified.r2_upload: Working correctly — 159 GLBs prove it. Errors are now logged at ERROR level.
pipeline_health_verified.glb_download: Working — refine fallback to preview mesh is correct behavior when refine fails
pipeline_health_verified.asset_url_reception: Unity receives paths like /api/glb/game-assets/v1/{hash}.glb — verified working in Supabase records

before_after.before: Placeholder cubes on every play due to play-during-script_ready bug
before_after.after: Real 3D models load when game is done; amber play button + modal during script_ready lets user choose to wait or play with placeholders
before_after.r2_before: Already had 159 GLBs — was never broken
before_after.r2_after: Same, plus retry resilience and full diagnostic logging

needs_manual_review.action: Verify they complete with 6 assets each. If still empty after 20 min, check server logs for Meshy errors on those specific game IDs.
With refine enabled, each game costs 90 credits (6 × 15). At 10+ games/day this is 900+ credits/day. Consider whether MESHY_SKIP_REFINE=true (5 credits/asset, 30/game) is acceptable for dev testing.
